VERDICT: QUALIFIED FOR STT POST-PROCESSING - high precision, low harm, limited recall.
approved_use: post-processing of Kreyòl STT transcripts, with the raw ASR string retained and reachable (TranscriptionResult.normalization.rawText).
NOT_approved_use: speech-first authoring of GOLD corpus records - at 0.48 WER a native author still corrects about one word in two, which is slower than typing
any path where normalized text becomes training data without a native speaker reading it
semantic repair - choosing between attested candidates is a different instrument
why_self_contained: the evaluation copy imports its lexicon from two files that are gitignored in the dev tree. A runtime doing the same would behave differently on a machine without them and would change behaviour whenever they were edited.
enforcement: npm run pilot:kreyol:verify (registered in pilot:verify) replays all 94 qualified vectors against THIS directory - the same bytes both callers load - and fails closed on any divergence in text OR reason code.
licence_acknowledgment: The lexicon is CMU-derived. Evaluation audio and reference transcripts come from the CMU Haitian Creole speech corpus, CMU Language Technologies Institute (c) 2010, MIT licence, condition 5 provenance acknowledgment.
governing_rule: The Kreyòl model's linguistic and cultural gold standard must originate with native Haitian speakers. This tool repairs spelling; it certifies nothing.
shared_by: services/speech-runtime/server.py (the runtime behind the Brain, and therefore behind the consumer MigraPilot app)
